run_knn_at_layer: run kNN nearest neighbor benchmark at a specified model layer to compute top-1 and top-5 accuracies
run_knn_at_layer_low_memory: run memory-optimized kNN benchmark that shards train features to avoid OOM on large datasets
run_knn_at_all_layers: run kNN evaluation across all trunk output feature layers with configurable top-k neighbors
extract_features_and_run_knn: extract features from a model checkpoint and run kNN benchmark to evaluate representation quality
extract_features_and_run_knn_on_slurm: submit a slurm job to extract features and run kNN benchmark in a distributed cluster environment
